evidence.summary: CASI describes the Naval University of Engineering in Wuhan as one of the PLA’s five comprehensive universities, formed in April 1999 by merging the PLA Navy’s engineering and electronic engineering academies. It trains naval officers in power, electronic, electrical and weapons engineering, ships and ocean engineering and information security, with water and sea training bases, a nuclear power operations training facility in Sichuan and a decommissioned destroyer for training.

CASI reports that the university has two national-level key laboratories, one of them the national defence science and technology key laboratory for ship integrated power technology, and six military key laboratories.
